summary: Frontend-only test of Aura 2 (Expo web preview) covering the 4 new features: Location Picker on Weather (+Flights), Live Radar on Weather, Sunset Dimming on Device, and Team Colors on Summary. All 4 features work end-to-end. Also verified the refactored Summary tab (index.tsx + summary/GlanceCard + helpers.ts) renders correctly, tabs navigate, and hide/reorder controls are present. No red screens, no runtime pageerrors, only benign RN-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, React 19 element.ref).
critical_code_review_comments: accentFor() intentionally falls back to brand amber for near-black teams (Cowboys navy #041E42). Verified visually with Arizona Cardinals red — icon accent tints red as expected. This matches the request wording 'reflect the team's color rather than the default amber for most teams'.
Sunset toggle correctly hides both HourStepper rows AND the entire 'Separate weekend schedule' section (weekend block sits inside the same !useSunset branch in device.tsx lines 306-353).
Persistence works via aura_settings_v1 in AsyncStorage; nightMode.useSunset survives full page reload.
RadarCard uses ESRI Dark Gray + RainViewer keyless tiles; both loaded (256x256) with no watermark. Marker dot renders over map. Caption 'Live precipitation radar · Esri · RainViewer' shown.
seed_data_creation: None. Used ZIP 10001 (New York) and Arizona Cardinals / Dallas Cowboys as sample teams.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verification results: 1) LOCATION PICKER (Weather + Flights): typing 10001 into 'Home ZIP code' geocoded to 'New York City, NY'. County line rendered as 'New York (Manhattan) County, NY · New York'. 'Alerts & temperature for New York City, NY' line shown. 'Use my location' button rendered on Weather AND Flights tabs; clicking it in headless browser did NOT crash the app (geolocation denied gracefully via detectLocation() try/catch). 2) LIVE RADAR: With ZIP set, radar map card renders below location card. Verified two elements loaded 256x256 with real bytes — one from server.arcgisonline.com (Dark Gray base) and one from tilecache.rainviewer.com (radar overlay). Caption reads 'Live precipitation radar · Esri · RainViewer'. No API-key watermark. State labels visible (NEW JERSEY, NEW YORK). 3) SUNSET DIMMING: On Device tab, toggling Night Dimming switch ON reveals Sunset-to-sunrise row + From/To steppers + Dim to slider + weekend section. Toggling Sunset-to-sunrise ON hides From/To steppers and 'Separate weekend schedule' block, keeps 'Dim to' slider, and hint text changes to include 'local sunset to sunrise'. Toggling OFF restores steppers + weekend. Full page reload after enabling Sunset preserved the setting (Sunset still ON, weekend still hidden). 4) TEAM COLORS ON SUMMARY: Added Arizona Cardinals via Sports tab team badge. Returned to Summary — Sports glance card label reads 'NFL · CARDINALS' and the leading trophy-icon accent container shows red team color (verified via computed backgroundColor: not the amber brand). Cowboys (navy #041E42) correctly falls back to amber per luminance rule <0.18 — expected behavior noted in code. Summary tab still renders, scrolls, and drag-reorder/hide/unhide controls are present. No deprecated packages detected. expo-audio (not expo-av) is used for chime, which is correct per current Expo policy. No SafeAreaView deprecation issues detected.
